From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Hart <sara.hart@datadog.com>, Alex Berman <alex@grafana.com>; OTel Alliance <otlp-support@opentelemetry.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Partner technical onboarding: OTLP gateway & marketplace checklist

Hi all,

Following up from last week's sync — we want to accelerate a joint onboarding track for the OTLP gateway and Marketplace listing. Goal: a reproducible integration we can market jointly (Grafana + Datadog friendly) by end of Q1.

High level asks from our side:
- Validation plan for OTLP export formats (protobuf & HTTP) and sample traces/metrics.
- Security checklist (service account, KMS integration, token rotation cadence).
- Marketplace package requirements and a recommended artifacts list.
- A short test harness or sample app we can use to smoke test routing and schema compatibility.

I've attached a draft integration_checklist.xlsx and a network infra diagram to start the convo. Can each of you highlight the top 3 technical risks you see and an initial ETA for a simple validation shim?

Thanks — Diego
Diego Fernandez
Senior Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Partner technical onboarding: OTLP gateway & marketplace checklist

Diego / team,

Thanks for the clear asks — this looks achievable. Quick notes from Datadog's side: 

1) Risk: schema drift on OTLP resource attributes. Recommendation: add a lightweight CI check that validates proto defs and fails on breaking changes. ETA: ~2 weeks for a baseline check.

2) Security: we can provide short-lived ingestion keys for the test harness. We'll need a minimal IP allowlist and proof-of-concept KMS envelope (we use AWS KMS). Can you confirm whether Redwood prefers KMS or an HSM-backed flow?

3) Marketplace: Datadog's listing requires an integration.yml and a short integration-runbook (1-2 pages). We can share templates.

Attachments: I attached a one-page SOC2 excerpt and our sample integration.yml for marketplace metadata.

Sincerely,
Sara Hart
Strategic Partnerships, Datadog
[sara.hart@datadog.com]
[Attachment: SOC2_excerpt.pdf (application/pdf)]

Diego / Monica — great to join this track. A few technical clarifications from Grafana's side: 

- We support both OTLP gRPC and OTLP/HTTP. For a gateway pattern we usually recommend: accept both, normalize to our internal proto, and surface a translation layer that preserves resource attributes.
- Test creds: we can spin up a temporary developer ingestion endpoint (credentials valid for 7 days). Please provide an egress IP range for the test client and a CSR if you need mTLS.
- Observability quality: we suggest a small eval harness that emits a mix of traces, metrics, and logs (sample app attached). Can you provide expected event rate (ops/sec) for the smoke tests?

Forwarding our recommended field mapping and a quick script to convert JSON->OTLP proto. Also looped in OTel for compatibility notes.

Best,
Alex Berman
Integration Lead, Grafana Labs
[Attachment: grafana_field_map.txt (text/plain)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>

Thanks, all — good signals here. Quick summary / next steps: 

1) Rishi to start the proto CI check. Monica will share Marketplace runbook template and I will confirm KMS preference (we'd like AWS KMS for the POC but will plan for HSM in private deployments).
2) Sara / Datadog: please provision test ingestion keys scoped to a single dataset and an IP allowlist for our dev runner.
3) Alex / Grafana: temporary ingestion endpoint + test creds for the sample app; we'll target a 1k events/sec smoke test (sustained 30s) for initial validation.
4) Compliance: Monica to confirm if marketplace listing requires full SOC2 or an excerpt.

I've attached the integration checklist and infra diagram with highlighted acceptance criteria. We'll follow up with a short weekly touch (calendar invite to go out).

Thanks — Diego
